Sentinel Tactics: The Flame of Freedom Kickstarter Backers
 
Some of these preorder items may be things that you are already expecting as a result of backing Sentinel Tactics: The Flame of Freedom, such as the Minions miniatures or the scenario maps. posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: In terms of the Tactics Kickstarter Add-On, I just put in a Purchase Order for the Minions miniatures today. The art for the maps is done, and the only thing left to do is pick out the exact material. We will be getting samples printed with our final art in the next week or two, which will let us confirm our material selection. Once that is done, I'll put in a Purchase Order for that stuff, and post an update on the Sentinel Tactics Kickstarter page with pictures and everything! Fortunately, I still think we are on track for a July 2015 delivery on that, precisely as advertised on the Kickstarter :)
